observation_summary: The StopWatch.getTime() method returns an incorrect, increased value after calling stop() following a suspend() operation.
reasoning_summary: The StopWatch class fails to maintain the correct time state when stop() is called after a suspend() operation. The bug report and the failing test indicate that the StopWatch continues to accumulate time even after it has been suspended, effectively treating the stop() call as if it were a split() or resume() operation. This indicates that the internal state management of the StopWatch does not correctly freeze the time accumulation upon suspension, leading to an incorrect total time calculation when the watch is stopped.
